native_mechanisms: Doubled shadow: one simultaneous illumination of both ropes reveals every same-dye crossing (every match cell) at once, without visiting the floor cell by cell.
Bare-floor cost between consecutive treasures is computed in closed form from how many knots each rope advances (index arithmetic), never by laying markers on intervening cells.
At each treasure keep only the cheapest arriving tally in each of two states (the single allowed 'slip' still whole, or already spent) and drop every dominated tally.
core_technique: Banded Needleman-Wunsch: a main-diagonal match count yields a score lower bound that certifies a band width W, then the band is filled by full DP — an AVX2 anti-diagonal (wavefront) int16 kernel with an int32 scalar row-DP fallback.
